text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This is great! Check out the<n>stands—everybody's
going wild!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Loads of folks called out to me on the<n>way here.
Reckon they're expecting<n>me to do well.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I really can't lose now! My heart's<n>about to burst
with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat Suzuka and everybody else.<n>And after that,
I'm gonna clinch the<n>rest of the G1 sprints too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh... you're lookin' a tad nervous,<n>Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well, turn that frown upside down!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Or rather, whatever I want to happenhappens!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Next stop, the finish line! Just take it<n>easy and wait
for me there, Trainer!
